name: Enemies to Lovers
source:
When your old tormentor returns to town, you find yourself closer to him than you'd ever hoped. I mean, it's hard to avoid him when he has the room next door.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当你的旧折磨者回到镇上时，你发现自己比你希望的更接近他。我的意思是，当他住在隔壁的房间时，很难避开他。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
